title: Scientists Reveal Climate Change Is a Political Hoax

claims.text: Global temperatures have not increased in the last 20 years.
claims.explanation: False. NASA data shows the last decade was the hottest on record, with 2023 being the warmest year globally.

claims.text: CO2 levels are natural and have been much higher in Earth's history.
claims.explanation: Partially true but misleading. While CO2 has been higher, current CO2 levels are the highest in 800,000 years.

claims.text: 97% of climate scientists agree that human activity causes climate change.
claims.explanation: True. Multiple peer-reviewed studies confirm the scientific consensus.

claims.text: Renewable energy is more expensive and doesn't reduce emissions.
claims.explanation: False. Solar and wind are now cheaper than coal in most countries and significantly reduce emissions.

claims.text: Sea levels are rising at an accelerating rate due to ice melt.
claims.explanation: True. NASA data confirms sea levels have risen 4 inches since 1993 with accelerating rates.

trust_score_description: Low - Only 2 out of 5 claims are properly sourced
